**About Eucalyptus**
 We’re on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We’re here to build better long\-term care.
   

  

 Euc is the company behind
 **Juniper** 
 , one of the world’s largest weight\-management programs combining GLP\-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician\-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our
 **published clinical research** 
 shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.
   

  

**Our Growth Story**
* 130% YoY revenue growth and 90% reduction in cash burn, with $100M\+ raised from investors including BOND, NewView, Blackbird and Airtree.
* Scaled to over 100,000 monthly active patients across our weight\-management program.
* Grew the UK patient base from 4,000 to \~40,000 and received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS.
* Tailored our offering to over 5,000 patients in Germany and Japan


**About The Role (What You’ll Be Doing)**
 As a
 **Data Scientist at Eucalyptus** 
 , you’ll use data, experimentation, and machine learning to help build the next generation of personalised healthcare experiences. You’ll work closely with
 **data engineers, ML engineers, and product teams** 
 to design, test, and evaluate data\-driven solutions that make a real impact on patient outcomes.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll focus on
 **applied modelling, production AI systems, analytical thinking, and experimentation.** 
 You will help translate ideas into prototypes and production\-ready insights. You’ll contribute to the full data science lifecycle: from exploring datasets and defining features, to evaluating models and interpreting results for decision\-makers.
   

  

* Develop and validate models: Build, test, and iterate on statistical and machine learning models to support product features and decision\-making.
* Collaborate with engineers: Work with data and ML engineers to move experiments into production and ensure reliability and interpretability.
* Explore and analyse data: Conduct exploratory analyses to identify patterns, generate hypotheses, and shape model or product directions.
* Design and measure experiments: Partner with product teams to run A/B tests or pilots, and translate results into actionable insights.
* Communicate findings: Present results clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, connecting data science outcomes to user and business impact.


**About You (Who You Are)**
 You’re an analytical thinker who’s comfortable turning data into insights and models into impact. You enjoy learning from others across disciplines and are eager to grow your technical and applied skills in a fast\-moving environment.
   

  

**You Have**
* 2–4 years of experience in data science, applied analytics, or machine learning.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using data science libraries such as pandas, scikit\-learn, and PyTorch.
* Experience exploring and cleaning large datasets, and understanding how data quality impacts modelling.
* A working knowledge of ML concepts, such as feature engineering, cross\-validation, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with cloud\-based data tools (e.g. BigQuery, Vertex AI, or similar).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders.
* A growth mindset \- curious, collaborative, and motivated to learn from feedback and experimentation.


**Why join Eucalyptus?**
 Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well\-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.
   

  

**Here’s What Makes Joining Euc Unique**
* What’s next \- Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
* Build something world\-changing \- We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast\-paced, and deeply rewarding.
* Make real impact \- You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence\-based care across markets.
* Accelerate your growth \- You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
* Join a motivated team \- You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.


 What’s ahead in Australia?
   

  

* Grow with us globally \- Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early\-career professionals to become future global leaders.
* Shape your career \- Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge\-sharing culture.
* Be an owner \- Equity for everyone means you share in our success.

title: Commercial Data Scientist
description:
**Role Summary** 




  





 At Law Partners, Australia's largest specialist personal injury law firm, our mission is simple: help more Australians get the compensation they deserve.
 



 We're building a commercial analytics capability to drive evidence\-based decision making across Marketing, Client Care and Partnerships. This is a data science role for someone who can apply statistical rigour, build predictive models and design experiments to improve lead quality, conversion rates across the end\-to\-end client intake funnel and ROI.
 



 You won't be measured by the sophistication of your models. You'll be measured by the quality of the business decisions you enable and the performance improvements you deliver.
 



  





**Why This Role Exists** 




  





 We're investing in data\-driven growth and we need someone who can:
 



  




* Build predictive models that improve lead scoring, partner prioritisation and conversion forecasting
* Design and run experiments to validate what's actually driving results
* Apply statistical methods to measure true incremental impact, not just correlations
* Translate technical analysis into business recommendations that stakeholders act on



  





 This is a high\-impact role with direct exposure to leadership and the opportunity to shape how we use data science to optimise commercial performance.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





 Predictive Modelling \& Analytics (40%)
 



  




* Build and deploy practical models that create measurable business value:
* Lead scoring and propensity to convert models
* Partner lead quality scoring and prioritisation
* Channel ROI prediction and marketing mix optimisation
* Early warning indicators for performance degradation
* Develop customer segmentation models to identify high\-value cohorts
* Apply forecasting techniques for pipeline planning and capacity management
* Monitor model performance and iterate based on business outcomes



  





**Experimentation \& Causal Analysis (30%)** 




  




* Design test\-and\-learn frameworks across marketing, partnerships and client care
* Apply causal inference methods to measure incremental impact (propensity score matching, difference\-in\-differences, instrumental variables)
* Distinguish causation from correlation in performance analysis
* Build experimentation infrastructure and educate teams on experimental design
* Provide leadership with evidence based on rigorous testing



  





**Performance Insights \& Recommendations (20%)** 




  




* Diagnose drivers of performance across acquisition channels and lead\-to\-client funnel
* Identify growth opportunities through analysis of channel mix, partner performance and conversion leakage
* Build decision frameworks that prioritise where to invest resources
* Translate complex statistical analysis into clear executive recommendations



  





**Data Foundations \& Collaboration (10%)** 




  




* Work with available data sources (CRM, client care systems, web analytics, marketing platforms)
* Improve data quality, tracking consistency and measurement definitions
* Partner with Marketing, Client Care, Partnerships and Finance teams to embed analytics into workflows
* Present technical findings in plain language that non\-technical stakeholders understand



  





**About You** 




  





**Essential Experience** 




  




* 4\+ years applying data science to commercial problems (marketing analytics, growth analytics, customer analytics, revenue optimisation)
* Proven track record building predictive models that drove measurable business outcomes
* Experience designing and analysing experiments (A/B tests, multivariate tests)
* Strong ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences
* Comfortable working with imperfect data and improving it over time



  





**Technical Skills (Required)** 




  




* Programming: Python or R for data analysis, modelling and statistical computing
* Statistics: regression analysis, hypothesis testing, experimental design, causal inference
* Machine Learning: classification, regression, ensemble methods (XGBoost, Random Forest, logistic regression)
* SQL: advanced querying for data extraction, transformation and exploratory analysis
* Data Visualisation: ability to create clear visualisations (matplotlib, seaborn, Tableau, Power BI)



  





**Technical Skills (Desirable)** 




  




* Experience with marketing platforms and APIs (Google Ads, Meta, Salesforce, CRM systems)
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) for scalable analytics
* Bayesian methods, time\-series analysis, survival analysis
* MLOps or model deployment experience



  





 What Makes You Stand Out
 



  




* Experience in lead generation or conversion\-focused businesses (legal, financial services, insurance, education)
* Background applying data science in multi\-channel marketing environments
* Track record influencing leadership decisions through data\-driven recommendations
* Consulting or strategy analytics background with commercial storytelling skills



  





**Core Capabilities** 




  




* Commercial mindset: you connect technical work to business value and ROI
* Pragmatic approach: you choose the right level of sophistication for the problem at hand
* Clear communicator: you explain complex methods simply and focus on actionable insights
* Structured thinker: you break down ambiguous problems into testable hypotheses
* Results\-oriented: you measure success by business impact, not technical elegance



  





**Why Law Partners?** 




  




* Purpose\-driven work: your models help more Australians access compensation they deserve
* High\-impact role: direct influence on commercial strategy and performance optimisation
* Technical challenge: apply advanced analytics to real business problems with measurable outcomes

title: Signal Engineer
description:
**About the role**
------------------


Maincode builds frontier AI models end to end. We design the models, run the infrastructure, and train on data we source and shape ourselves. What we have been calling a “data scientist” does not actually exist in the market in the form we need. The work we are doing is frontier work. It changes continuously as models, methods, and training regimes evolve, and there is no stable body of prior experience that reliably predicts success.

  

This role is best understood internally as a **Signal Engineer**.


The real work here is not analytics, dashboards, or big data engineering.


It is about how AI models learn, and specifically how the quality, composition, timing, and structure of input signal shapes learning outcomes across the full training lifecycle, from early pre training through mid training, post training, supervised fine tuning, and reinforcement learning.


The analogy we use internally is a fuels engineer for a race car. The engine matters, but performance is ultimately unlocked by obsessing over the fuel. What goes in, how it is blended, when it is introduced, and how it changes under different conditions.

**What you would actually do**
------------------------------


You would be responsible for designing, sourcing, shaping, and evaluating input signal at scale so that models learn faster, learn better, and generalize more effectively.


This includes:

* Working deeply with raw and synthetic data
* Designing new datasets and signal mixtures
* Iterating on input distributions and formats
* Understanding how small changes in signal affect training behavior
* Thinking across stages of training, not in isolation
* Treating data as a dynamic, evolving system rather than a static asset


This is not about knowing the right answer up front. It is about immersion, experimentation, and developing intuition through long feedback loops.

**The kind of person who does well here**
-----------------------------------------


Success in this role is driven almost entirely by cognitive traits and working style, not prior AI experience.


People who tend to thrive here:

* Have extreme attention to detail and care deeply about precision
* Are comfortable with long arcs of repetitive, detailed work
* Enjoy staring at complex, noisy information until structure emerges
* Are excited by tuning, blending, and calibrating inputs
* Have high stamina and patience
* Learn new technical domains very quickly when given dense material
* Get intrinsic satisfaction from incremental improvement and deep understanding


These are people who do not get bored easily. They metabolize boredom into insight. They are depth driven rather than novelty driven.


We explicitly do not require prior experience with large language models or modern AI training. No one meaningfully has that experience yet. What matters is learning gradient, range, and willingness to throw yourself into the problem space.

**How you would work**
----------------------


You would spend your time inside computational environments and technical tooling.


You do not need to identify as a software engineer, but you should be comfortable:

* Working directly with data through scripts, notebooks, and experimental pipelines
* Modifying existing systems and building small utilities to explore questions
* Using code as a tool for thinking, testing, and refinement


The goal is speed of learning and depth of understanding, not polish.

**Backgrounds that often fit well**
-----------------------------------


Rather than advertising this role directly, we look for people in fields that reward signal sensitivity, precision, and long horizon reasoning.


We expect to see strong candidates from areas such as:

* Actuarial science
* Forensic accounting or forensic finance
* Quantum computing
* Quantitative risk modeling
* Applied statistics and signal processing
* Econometrics
* Operations research


We also see excellent fits from applied mathematics, computational physics, systems engineering, bioinformatics, reliability engineering, and similar disciplines.


Many people in these fields are constrained by conservative or slow moving industries and are actively looking for something more dynamic, even if they do not yet realize there is a place for them in frontier AI.

**How we interview**
--------------------


We are explicitly hiring for learning gradient, not recall.


Our process is designed to:

* See how quickly you build a mental model of an unfamiliar system
* Understand how you reason about signal, feedback, and failure modes
* Observe how deeply you engage with input quality as a lever
* Learn whether you enjoy the work itself, not just the outcome


Correctness matters less than depth, curiosity, and systems intuition.

**The core message**
--------------------


We are offering a path for people who love signal, precision, and deep work to apply that obsession to frontier AI.


This role is not about having the right background. It is about having the right brain, the right stamina, and the desire to become excellent at something that does not quite have a name yet.

title: Data Scientist
description:
At LeavePlus, we’re committed to building data\-driven products that make leave management simple, fair and accessible for everyone. This is a parental leave contract to build valuable experience and play an important role in a data team that directly improves member experience and operational efficiency. We’re looking for a collaborative, curious Data Scientist to join a cross\-functional team working on high\-impact analytics. You’ll help turn complex data into clear insights, reliable models and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Drive insight\-led decisions: Analyse large, messy datasets to identify trends, opportunities and risks that will shape product and business strategy.
* Build and deploy models: Develop, validate and productionise predictive models and scoring systems (e.g. classification, time\-to\-event, recommendation) with a focus on reliability and fairness.
* Collaborate across teams: Partner with product, engineering and operations to define problems, design experiments, instrument telemetry and translate results into actionable roadmaps.
* Communicate with impact: Present clear, evidence\-based recommendations to stakeholders using visualisations and narrative that make complex analysis accessible.
* Improve processes and standards: Champion reproducible workflows, robust testing, monitoring and documentation for data and models.


**What You’ll Bring**
* Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with experience in applied modelling and experiment design.
* Skilled in Python or R and experience with data tools (SQL, pandas, scikit\-learn, or equivalent).
* Proficiency in Microsoft Azure, Azure: Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Machine Learning, HDInsight, Cosmos DB, DevOps
* Experience working with large, structured and unstructured datasets and familiarity with feature engineering and data pipelines.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical colleagues and influence product decisions.
* A collaborative mindset and commitment to ethical, inclusive data practices.


**What You’ll Need To Have**
* 3\+ years’ experience in a data science, applied research or analytics role (or equivalent).
* Practical experience building and validating predictive models, and deploying them into production or near\-production environments.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with at least one programming language for data analysis (Python preferred).
* Familiarity with modern data engineering or MLOps concepts (versioning, CI/CD, monitoring) is desirable.


**Why join us?**
* Play a key role in a mission\-driven company where your work directly improves people’s lives.
* Work in a supportive, inclusive team that values curiosity, learning and collaboration.
* Opportunities for professional development, training and time to pursue technical improvements.
* A culture that celebrates diversity and encourages new ideas where your perspective will be valued.


**Ready to make an impact?** 
 Apply with your CV and a short cover letter telling us about a data project you’re proud of and why this role excites you.

title: Quantum Computing Researcher
description:
**Please read this first**
 We know that this job title says we are looking for a Quantum Computing Researcher. In practice, this role is not that at all.
   

  

 We are using this title because people with backgrounds like yours tend to have the kind of brain that does exceptionally well here, even though the work itself does not fit neatly into an existing category.
   

  

 Maincode builds frontier AI models end to end. We design the models, run the infrastructure, and train on data we source and shape ourselves. What we have been calling a “data scientist” does not actually exist in the market in the form we need. The work we are doing is frontier work. It changes continuously as models, methods, and training regimes evolve, and there is no stable body of prior experience that reliably predicts success.
   

  

 This role is best understood internally as a
 **Signal Engineer** 
 .
   

  

**What This Role Actually Is**
 The real work here is not analytics, dashboards, or big data engineering.
   

  

 It is about how AI models learn, and specifically how the quality, composition, timing, and structure of input signal shapes learning outcomes across the full training lifecycle, from early pre training through mid training, post training, supervised fine tuning, and reinforcement learning.
   

  

 The analogy we use internally is a fuels engineer for a race car. The engine matters, but performance is ultimately unlocked by obsessing over the fuel. What goes in, how it is blended, when it is introduced, and how it changes under different conditions.
   

  

**What You Would Actually Do**
 You would be responsible for designing, sourcing, shaping, and evaluating input signal at scale so that models learn faster, learn better, and generalize more effectively.
   

  

**This Includes**
* Working deeply with raw and synthetic data
* Designing new datasets and signal mixtures
* Iterating on input distributions and formats
* Understanding how small changes in signal affect training behavior
* Thinking across stages of training, not in isolation
* Treating data as a dynamic, evolving system rather than a static asset


 This is not about knowing the right answer up front. It is about immersion, experimentation, and developing intuition through long feedback loops.
   

  

**The Kind Of Person Who Does Well Here**
 Success in this role is driven almost entirely by cognitive traits and working style, not prior AI experience.
   

  

**People Who Tend To Thrive Here**
* Have extreme attention to detail and care deeply about precision
* Are comfortable with long arcs of repetitive, detailed work
* Enjoy staring at complex, noisy information until structure emerges
* Are excited by tuning, blending, and calibrating inputs
* Have high stamina and patience
* Learn new technical domains very quickly when given dense material
* Get intrinsic satisfaction from incremental improvement and deep understanding


 These are people who do not get bored easily. They metabolize boredom into insight. They are depth driven rather than novelty driven.
   

  

 We explicitly do not require prior experience with large language models or modern AI training. No one meaningfully has that experience yet. What matters is learning gradient, range, and willingness to throw yourself into the problem space.
   

  

**How You Would Work**
 You would spend your time inside computational environments and technical tooling.
   

  

 You do not need to identify as a software engineer, but you should be comfortable:
   

  

* Working directly with data through scripts, notebooks, and experimental pipelines
* Modifying existing systems and building small utilities to explore questions
* Using code as a tool for thinking, testing, and refinement


 The goal is speed of learning and depth of understanding, not polish.
   

  

**Backgrounds that often fit well**
 Rather than advertising this role directly, we look for people in fields that reward signal sensitivity, precision, and long horizon reasoning.
   

  

 We expect to see strong candidates from areas such as:
   

  

* Actuarial science
* Forensic accounting or forensic finance
* Quantum computing
* Quantitative risk modeling
* Applied statistics and signal processing
* Econometrics
* Operations research


 We also see excellent fits from applied mathematics, computational physics, systems engineering, bioinformatics, reliability engineering, and similar disciplines.
   

  

 Many people in these fields are constrained by conservative or slow moving industries and are actively looking for something more dynamic, even if they do not yet realize there is a place for them in frontier AI.
   

  

**How We Interview**
 We are explicitly hiring for learning gradient, not recall.
   

  

**Our Process Is Designed To**
* See how quickly you build a mental model of an unfamiliar system
* Understand how you reason about signal, feedback, and failure modes
* Observe how deeply you engage with input quality as a lever
* Learn whether you enjoy the work itself, not just the outcome


 Correctness matters less than depth, curiosity, and systems intuition.
   

  

**The core message**
 We are offering a path for people who love signal, precision, and deep work to apply that obsession to frontier AI.
   

  

 This role is not about having the right background. It is about having the right brain, the right stamina, and the desire to become excellent at something that does not quite have a name yet.

description:
**Job Req ID:** 17086
**Description:****Aramco energizes the world economy.**
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our Global Optimizer Department.  



The Global Optimizer Department is responsible for driving commercial optimization across Saudi Aramco’s integrated downstream value chain, which includes both domestic and international refining assets. This involves identifying and capturing optimization opportunities that enhance system netback and deliver incremental value to shareholders. The department also collaborates closely with downstream assets, Aramco Trading Company, and key stakeholders to support informed decision\-making and agile responses to dynamic market conditions by leveraging advanced analytics, data modeling, and real\-time market insights,  



Your primary role is to develop and deploy digital solutions that enhance the iGO (intelligent Global Optimizer) platform, enabling data\-driven optimization decision support. You will also design and implement advanced analytical models, automate data pipelines, and apply machine learning techniques to improve forecasting, scenario modeling, and optimization sensitivity analysis. By transforming complex data into actionable insights, you will support forward planning, simulation, and continuous learning to refine strategies and maximize the value captured across Saudi Aramco's refining and petrochemical assets.
Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:  


* Develop and implement advanced data models and machine learning algorithms to support optimization decision\-making within the iGO platform.
* Design and automate data pipelines that integrate, cleanse, and enrich large datasets from multiple sources to ensure high\-quality inputs for optimization models.
* Build and maintain predictive and prescriptive analytics tools that enhance scenario modeling, forecasting, and back casting capabilities to improve optimization throughput.
* Assess the effectiveness of existing data\-driven models and continuously refine them based on feedback loops and performance metrics.
* Perform statistical analysis and sensitivity analysis to identify key optimization levers and prioritize high\-impact opportunities across refining and petrochemical assets.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable digital solutions that support agile and responsive optimization.
* Ensure that all digital solutions align with enterprise data standards, cybersecurity protocols, and overall IT architecture.
* Document technical specifications and maintain version\-controlled repositories to support continuous development and model governance.
Minimum Requirements
* You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field from a recognized and approved program. An advanced degree is preferred.
* You will have at least 10 years’ experience in data analytics, machine learning, or quantitative modeling, including at least 5 years in developing enterprise\-level AI and machine learning applications.
* You must have strong programming skills in Python, SQL, and experience with data science libraries and frameworks such as Pandas, Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
* You will have the ability to design and manage data pipelines using modern data engineering tools such as Apache Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.
* You will be able to demonstrate a proven track record in deploying analytics solutions in an industrial or energy sector environment.
* You will have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic and complex environment.
* You will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively present findings and technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You will also have a solid understanding of cloud platforms such as GCP, Cloudera, Databricks, Palantir Foundry, AWS or Azure, with experience in deploying and managing models in production environments.
* Knowledge of optimization techniques, linear programming, or operations research is preferred.
Work Location and Work Schedule
**Work Location:** Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer


**Work Schedule:** Full Time \- To be specified in Job offer


Job Post Duration

Job posting start date: 1/14/2026



Job posting end date: 12/30/2026

**Working environment**Our high\-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world\-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector\-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.  


**Country/Region:** SA

description:

We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.

We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other. *Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. For more information, visit our careers blog.*  

As a Senior AI Product Designer, you will work on our products that help people action insights, govern data, and export their data to their data warehouse. Your primary focus will be to lead the design of intuitive, impactful experiences, helping us achieve product\-market fit while elevating design quality. In particular you will be working on data related features that are useful, viable and generate trust in our users. You will have the opportunity to help shape the foundations of our experiences. You’ll also be working on AI related workflows. You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and leadership to bring concepts to life while ensuring functionality, usability, and delight for our users. * A mix of **0 to 1** product development, and solving user problems in established parts of our products

* **Communicate Effectively:** Present design solutions clearly to stakeholders at all levels, both technical and non technical. articulating the "why" behind your design decisions.

description:
CGI is the world's 5th largest independent IT and business consulting services firm, operating across 40 countries and delivering more than 100 IP\-based solutions to clients in Financial Services, Government, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Utilities, Oil \& Gas, and more. We are recognized globally for our on\-time, on\-budget delivery and our role as a trusted advisor to leading organizations.  

As organizations accelerate their data and analytics modernization, CGI is expanding its Data \& AI consulting practice. We are seeking a Data Architecture Consultant with deep expertise in Lakehouse architecture, data modeling, governance, and regulatory reporting, ideally with experience in highly regulated industries such as Energy, Utilities, Financial Services or Government.  

Join our team and help design and implement enterprise\-scale analytics platforms that enable trusted insights, advanced analytics, and regulatory compliance.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**


As a Data Architect, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end architecture and design of enterprise Lakehouse platforms built on Databricks. You will define and govern Bronze, Silver, and Gold data zones, establish metadata and data quality standards, and design Unity Catalog structures that enable secure, scalable analytics and regulatory reporting.  

You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineering Consultants, Data Scientists, Cloud Architecture Consultants, and Business Stakeholders to ensure data platforms are well\-governed, performant, auditable, and aligned to business and regulatory requirements.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

Lakehouse Architecture \& Data Modeling  

  

. Architect and design Databricks Lakehouse solutions using Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, ensuring clear separation of ingestion, refinement, and consumption.  

. Define enterprise data models optimized for analytics, BI, and regulatory reporting.  

. Establish data design standards for schemas, naming conventions, partitioning, and performance optimization.  

. Ensure Lakehouse designs support both batch and streaming data workloads.  

  

Metadata, Governance \& Unity Catalog  

  

. Design and implement Unity Catalog architectures, including catalogs, schemas, tables, views, and access controls.  

. Define metadata standards, data ownership models, and lineage practices to support auditability and regulatory compliance.  

. Implement fine\-grained access controls aligned with enterprise security, privacy, and compliance requirements.  

. Partner with governance and risk teams to ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks and internal data policies.  

  

Analytics \& Regulatory Reporting Enablement  

  

. Architect Gold\-layer datasets optimized for BI tools, regulatory submissions, and executive reporting.  

. Ensure data structures support reproducibility, traceability, and explainability of metrics.  

. Collaborate with analytics and reporting teams to align data models with business definitions and regulatory rules.  

. Support data quality monitoring, validation frameworks, and exception handling.  

  

Cloud \& Platform Integration  

  

. Design Databricks architectures integrated with cloud\-native services (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse, Azure Key Vault).  

. Define ingestion patterns using tools such as Auto Loader, Delta Live Tables, and structured streaming.  

. Ensure platform designs meet enterprise requirements for scalability, resilience, cost optimization, and operational monitoring.  

  

Client Advisory \& Delivery Leadership  

  

. Act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders on Lakehouse architecture, data strategy, and analytics modernization.  

. Lead architecture workshops, define target\-state architectures, and produce high\-quality solution design documentation.  

. Provide technical leadership across delivery teams, guiding best practices and architectural decision\-making.

Qualifications  

Must\-Have Technical Experience  

  

. 8–12\+ years of experience in data architecture, analytics platforms, or data engineering, including: Databricks Lakehouse architecture Delta Lake (tables, optimization, versioning) Bronze / Silver / Gold data modeling patterns Unity Catalog design and governance

. Deep understanding of data governance, metadata management, and security controls.

Additional Assets

This role requires strong construction domain knowledge, technical data skills, and the ability to collaborate closely with delivery teams to understand how work actually happens on site and in projects.

Currently, Atreides focuses on providing high\-fidelity data solutions to enable customers to derive insights quickly.

  



Atreides transforms the chaos of petabyte\-scale, all\-domain data—land, air, sea, space, and cyber—into real\-time operational clarity. We are a fast\-moving, high\-performance international scale company. We trust our team with autonomy, believing it leads to better results and job satisfaction. With a mission\-driven mindset and entrepreneurial spirit, we are building something new and helping unlock the power of massive\-scale data to make the world safer, stronger, and more prosperous.

  


**Team Overview:** We are a passionate team of technologists, data scientists, and analysts with backgrounds in operational intelligence, law enforcement, large multinationals, and cybersecurity operations. We obsess about designing products that will change the way global companies, governments and nonprofits protect themselves from external threats and global adversaries.

 **Position Overview****:**We are seeking a Senior Manager of Engineering to lead the full stack teams building end\-to\-end solutions for users to interact with Atreides data. Your teams will design and deliver datastores, APIs, and user interfaces that allow users to query, visualize, and export data from our fusion engines.



You will recruit, manage, and grow a team of engineers building high\-quality, maintainable, and scalable software. You will collaborate closely with Infrastructure, SRE, Data Engineering, Cyber Security, and our Analyst and Product teams to deliver capabilities for our internal and external customers.

 **Team Principles:**



At Atreides, our teams thrive on:


* Curiosity and passion in all aspects of our work
* Clear, direct communication
* Embracing efficiency and innovation
* Valuing diverse ideas and technologies
* Leading with empathy in all interactions

  


**Responsibilities:**


**People \& Leadership**


* Lead, mentor, and coach full stack engineers, providing technical guidance and career development.
* Actively recruit and hire top talent in partnership with the Recruiting/People team.
* Create a culture where respectful debate is encouraged, followed by strong alignment and execution (“disagree and commit”).
* Maintain a steady, composed approach under pressure, guiding teams through ambiguity and technical complexity while staying focused on mission\-critical outcomes.


**Product, Domain \& Stakeholder Collaboration**


* Partner with Product Management, Analysts, and BD to define and deliver the roadmap for user\-facing applications over Atreides data fusion products.
* Work directly with internal and external users to understand workflows around querying, visualizing, and exporting geospatial and multi\-modal data (examples include satellite, RF, OPIR, Ad Tech, AIS/ADSB, CTV, FMV).
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, Cyber Security, Data Engineering, and vendor support to identify and resolve cross\-team risks, dependencies, and constraints.


**Technical Leadership \& Delivery**


* Provide architectural direction for full stack systems including web frontends, APIs, and backend services.
* Ensure the stack is modern and maintainable:
* Frontend using modern JavaScript/TypeScript and frameworks such as React
* Backend using modern server\-side languages (e.g., Python) and frameworks (e.g., FastAPI).
* Data infrastructure including relational SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), OLAP engines (e.g., DuckDB, StarRocks), and data lake technologies (e.g., Iceberg, Snowflake).
* Cloud environments on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
* Ensure systems can support rapid data ingestion, complex processing, and low\-latency queries on extremely large datasets.
* Own and evolve engineering best practices: code review standards, CI/CD, automated testing, deployment strategies, and documentation.


**Reliability, Operations \& Incident Management**


* Ensure high availability for customer\-facing systems, meeting strict customer availability requirements.
* Define and guide the implementation of monitoring, logging, and alerting to enable proactive issue detection and performance optimization.
* Design and enforce an on\-call structure and escalation paths in partnership with SRE; ensure clear ownership for system components.
* Foster a culture of operational excellence via structured post\-mortems and continuous improvement after incidents.
* Provide leadership for remote and on\-site system support (including after\-hours rotation), ensuring engineering is appropriately engaged on critical issues.
* Oversee preventive, corrective, and adaptive maintenance practices (e.g., log analysis, software deployments, and hardware/LRU coordination with relevant teams).


**Cloud Cost Management \& KPIs**


* Partner with Infrastructure and Finance to manage cloud costs across AWS/Azure/GCP, balancing performance, scalability, and spend.
* Implement and govern cost monitoring, budget controls, and rightsizing strategies for compute, storage, and networking.
* Define, track, and socialize engineering KPIs (e.g., reliability, throughput, defect rates, incident metrics) to drive transparency and continuous improvement.

  


**Desired Qualifications:**


* Proven experience growing and managing remote engineering teams delivering complex end\-to\-end full stack applications.
* Strong technical background across:
* Modern server\-side development (Ruby, Python, Node or similar) and web frameworks (Rails, Django, Express, etc.).
* Modern frontend development (ES6\+, React or similar frameworks).
* Web APIs, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web server technologies (e.g., Nginx, WebSockets).
* Multiple database paradigms: relational SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), OLAP (e.g., DuckDB, StarRocks), and data lake technologies (e.g., Iceberg, Snowflake).
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).
* Demonstrated track record of building high\-quality, maintainable, tested, and scalable software systems.
* Strong troubleshooting, fault isolation, and problem\-solving skills; able to guide teams to root cause and durable fixes.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to drive clarity on complex technical topics and have direct conversations when needed.
* Experience setting and tracking measurable goals, and driving accountability at team and individual levels.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in cross\-functional project settings.
* Willingness to support occasional travel and after\-hours work when critical technical issues arise.
* Bonus: Knowledge or experience in visualizing remote sensing, GIS, satellite ground stations, satellite communication systems, RF communication links, and electrical/mechanical systems.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**About STATSports:**



What if the product you helped to build next week was worn by an elite athlete the week after?

  

At STATSports, that could be your reality.

  

Since 2007, we’ve grown from a small Irish start\-up into the global leader in GPS performance tracking, trusted by the world’s biggest clubs, leagues, and athletes. Our technology sits at the intersection of hardware, software, and sport, helping teams optimise performance, reduce injury risk, and unlock insights that were previously impossible.

  

But just as importantly, our products support the next generation of athletes, from academies to grassroots, giving them access to the same performance tools as the pros.

  

Innovation has always driven us forward, and it’s our people who make that happen.

 **The opportunity:**



We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our product team and help turn vast datasets from our GPS and IMU sensors into actionable insights that shape the future of sports technology.

  


This is a hands\-on, research and data\-driven role where you’ll develop, test, and deploy machine learning and AI solutions that enhance the performance, accuracy, and capabilities of our software. You’ll work closely with software engineers, product owners, and stakeholders, turning data into real\-world value for athletes and teams.

  


If you enjoy finding patterns in complex data, building models that directly influence real products, and seeing your work applied in elite sport, this role is for you.

 **What you’ll be doing:**


* Designing, building, and deploying machine learning (ML) and AI models to extract insights from GPS and IMU sensor data
* Developing efficient ETL workflows to ensure data is extracted, transformed, and loaded for analysis
* Analysing large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that support athlete performance and team decisions
* Conducting experiments and validating models to ensure reliability and accuracy
* Monitoring and refining models over time to improve performance and efficiency
* Collaborating closely with software engineers, product owners, and other stakeholders to integrate data\-driven solutions into our products
* Staying up to date with the latest developments in data science, ML, AI, and cloud technologies to drive innovation
* Presenting insights clearly to cross\-functional teams and supporting data\-informed decision making

  


**What we’re looking for:**



You’ll likely enjoy this role if you:


* Have a degree or relevant experience in Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
* Are proficient in Python for data analysis and model development
* Have experience working with SQL and relational databases such as SQL Server or MySQL
* Have proven experience developing and deploying data science, ML, or AI solutions in a production environment
* Are familiar with ETL processes and tools
* Can analyse large datasets from cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and extract meaningful insights
* Have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams and communicating complex findings clearly

  


**Nice to have (but not essential):**


* Experience using data visualisation tools like Tableau or Power BI
* Experience in sports analytics or working with player tracking systems
* Familiarity with advanced ML techniques, time\-series analysis, or signal processing

  


**What’s in it for you:**


* A hands\-on role where your work directly influences products used in elite sport
* The opportunity to work with cutting\-edge datasets and develop innovative ML/AI solutions
* Exposure to the full software lifecycle, from data ingestion to deployment in production
* Collaboration with engineers, product owners, and data specialists in a supportive, high\-performance team
* The chance to see your work applied to real\-world athlete performance and decision\-making

  



If you enjoy working with data, building ML/AI solutions, and creating insights that have a tangible impact in sport, we’d love to hear from you.

 **Equal opportunity employer:**



STATSports is an equal opportunity employer. If you feel you would be a great addition to the team and are excited by the prospect of forging an impactful career with us, we would love to hear from you. We would particularly welcome applications from women and underrepresented groups.  

  

No one wins unless everyone wins!  

  

We believe that diverse teams have the greatest impact, so we really care about creating a diverse and inclusive environment. At STATSports, no one wins unless everyone wins, so we’re focused on creating a team where everyone feels they belong. We welcome people from all backgrounds, with different perspectives, ideas and experiences to work with us. If you do, you'll be joining an environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to share their opinion, showcase their skills, develop their career and be part of a caring and inclusive team.

 **Why STATSports:**



We’re still a small business that happens to be the world leader in our field, which means you can be a part of something big. Working at STATSports, you’ll have a real impact and see directly how the day\-to\-day work you do makes a difference in sport at the elite level.

  

You’ll collaborate with a world\-class team and be given the freedom to innovate, create and deliver at the highest level. If this excited you, then we would love to hear from you!

title: Data Scientist mit AI Fokus (w/m/x)
description:
IBM iX – Experience the Human Factor.


Du begeisterst dich dafür, modernste KI\-Technologien einzusetzen und komplexe Datensätze in umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu verwandeln? Wir suchen einen dynamischen Data Scientist (w/m/x) mit Fachkenntnissen in den Bereichen Advanced Analytics und Machine Learning, um Innovationen voranzutreiben und datengestützte Entscheidungsprozesse in unserem Unternehmen zu unterstützen.  

  

Klingt das nach dir? Dann suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt für eine Vollzeitstelle in Wien oder Berlin (Hybrid\-Work\-Modell mit 2 Tagen Anwesenheit pro Woche in unserem iX Studio).


Deine Aufgaben


* Du wendest Advanced Analytics, statistische Modellierung und Machine Learning Techniken an, um Trends und Erkenntnisse aus großen, komplexen Datensätzen zu gewinnen
* Rohdaten verwandelst du in aussagekräftige Informationen, um Geschäftsabläufe zu optimieren und strategische Initiativen zu unterstützen
* Du arbeitest mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um Möglichkeiten zu identifizieren, wie KI und LLMs Prozesse verbessern oder kritische Herausforderungen lösen können
* Du entwickelst und implementierst KI\-gesteuerte Lösungen, die mit den Unternehmenszielen in Einklang stehen und die Gesamteffizienz verbessern
* Neueste Entwicklungen im Bereich der KI\-Technologien \& Agent Development behältst du stets im Blick und integrierst diese in deine Arbeit, um einen Wettbewerbsvorteil zu sichern

Deine Fähigkeiten


* Du verfügst über mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung in den Bereichen Data Science, Analytik oder einem verwandten Gebiet und kannst nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Machine\-Learning\-Techniken vorweisen
* Du hast studiert und einen erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Bachelor\- oder Master\-Abschluss in Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder einem ähnlichen Fachgebiet
* Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Programmierkenntnisse in Python, R oder anderen relevanten Sprachen sowie über Erfahrung mit KI\-Frameworks wie TensorFlow oder PyTorch
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in statistischer Modellierung und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Tableau oder Power BI bringst du mit
* Im Umgang mit KI\-Technologien, einschließlich Large Language Models (z. B. GPT) und deren Anwendungen zur Lösung geschäftlicher Herausforderungen, bist du versiert
* Du hast Erfahrung in der Arbeit in agilen Umgebungen, der Teilnahme an iterativen Entwicklungszyklen und der Anpassung an sich ändernde Anforderungen
* Deine ausgezeichneten Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Problemlösung, Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit machen dich zu einer Bereicherung für jedes Team
* Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Englisch\- und Deutschkenntnisse (C1\-Niveau in Englisch und C2\-Niveau in Deutsch)

Deine Perspektive



Professional Growth
  

Wir bieten verschiedene Möglichkeiten zur individuellen Weiterentwicklung durch unsere interne Akademie und „Design yourself“\-Programme, einschließlich Inhouse\-Coaching und Mentoring. Außerdem hast du vollen Zugang zu allen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten von IBM.
  

  

Work\-Life Balance
  

Unsere Kernarbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstage und Hybrid\-Work\-Modell helfen dir, dein Leben flexibler zu gestalten.
  

  

Health \& Well\-Being
  

Dein Wohlbefinden ist genauso wichtig, wie deine Gesundheit. Deshalb bieten wir unterschiedliche Maßnahmen im Bereich Mental Health an, die deine mentale und körperliche Gesundheit stärken.
  

  

Team \& Culture
  

Unser Ziel ist es, dass sich jeder sicher, gebraucht und wertgeschätzt fühlt. Freue dich auf tolle Team\- und Firmen\-Events.


Corporate Benefits \& Incentives
  

Profitiere von großartigen IBM\-Rabatten und von internen Incentives, die deinen Einsatz würdigen, wie unser „Bring a friend“ Bonus\-Programm.


Über uns



Mit 60 Studios weltweit zählt IBM iX zu den größten Anbietern für Digital Experience Services weltweit. Als Teil von IBM Consulting, der Beratungs\- und Serviceeinheit von IBM, ist IBM iX Beratung, Digitalagentur, Design\-Studio und Tech\-Company in einem. An der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Design und Technologie begleiten die Teams Organisationen, Unternehmen und Marken bei der digitalen Transformation. Im deutschsprachigen Raum gestalten Expert\*innen digitale Erlebnisse, die den Menschen in den Mittelpunkt stellen – basierend auf IBM Technologien und in Zusammenarbeit mit führenden Technologiepartnern wie Adobe, Salesforce und SAP CX.



Du fühlst dich in der Welt der digitalen Trends zu Hause und liebst es, Projekte mit echter Wirkung voranzutreiben? Dann werde Teil unseres IBM iX Teams!


IBM iX widmet sich der Schaffung eines inklusiven Arbeitsumfeldes, das Chancengleichheit für alle bietet. Wir möchten insbesondere alle Menschen mit ihren individuellen, diversen Hintergründen und Perspektiven darin bestärken, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit aktuellem Lebenslauf, Arbeitszeugnissen und sehr gern auch einem kurzen Motivationsschreiben.
